visual.general_description: Six-panel montage (A-F) of axial chest CT slices from case 1: early mild changes, a 2-week follow-up, a slice with large pneumothorax and diffuse lung opacification, a post-drainage slice with persistent diffuse opacities, and two late follow-up slices with much clearer lungs.
visual.detailed_description: Montage of six grayscale axial chest CT images in two rows of three (A-C top, D-F bottom), each with a white capital letter at its upper left; no arrows, scale bars, patient text, dates or L/R markers. A and B show mostly aerated lungs with subtle haze. C is an obliquely positioned slice with a large black air-filled hemithorax on the image-right and a collapsed lung beside the mediastinum, and dense patchy opacity in the image-left lung with air bronchograms. D shows diffuse bilateral hazy lung density, reticulation and scattered small dark air pockets in posterior lungs without visible free pleural air. E and F show largely aerated lungs with mild residual haze and linear opacities. Windowing and slice level differ between panels.

No air-filled pleural space, rib-edge pneumothorax line or large pleural effusion is evident. No arrows, measurements, laterality markers or text other than the letter A.

visual.general_description: Two-panel montage (A-B) of axial chest CT slices from case 3: an initial scan with fine lung markings and a 4-week scan with more extensive reticular lung pattern.
visual.detailed_description: Montage of two grayscale axial chest CT images side by side, each with a white capital letter at upper left (A, B); no arrows, scale bars, patient text or L/R markers. A shows mostly dark lungs with thin fine lines, concentrated posteriorly. B shows both lungs with extensive fine reticular lines and mild haze, with two small bright dots over the anterior chest wall at upper right. Window and slice level are similar but not identical.

panels.general_description: Axial chest CT of case 3 at presentation with fine linear lung markings.
panels.detailed_description: Single axial CT slice at the level of the main bronchi, panel letter A at upper left. Both lungs are mostly dark with thin fine linear/reticular lines, most apparent in the posterior lungs and image-right base; the heart and central airways are normally displayed. No pneumothorax or large effusion; no arrows or markers.
